text:
nikita: Heads-up — found two odd parity behaviors between REST and Node SDK while wiring up autoscaling + streaming auth flow in the new sample app.

rahul: what happened?

nikita: 1) when creating a deployment via SDK, nested `scaling` object gets dropped unless I pass `scaling: {min_nodes:1}` instead of camelCase `minNodes`. REST accepts camelCase and the server-side orchestration sees the field. SDK serialiser transforms keys to snake_case and server-side schema only recognizes camelCase for now.

kevin: interesting — our OpenAPI moved to camelCase last year. SDK generator has a flag to convertPropertyNames, maybe that was toggled. Can you paste the payloads?

nikita: proxied requests:
```
// REST curl body (works)
{"name":"beta","model":"gpt-small","scaling":{"minNodes":1,"maxNodes":4}}

// SDK outgoing body (omitted server keys)
{"name":"beta","model":"gpt-small","scaling":{"min_nodes":1,"max_nodes":4}}
```

flo: so server rejects/ignores min_nodes and falls back to defaults?

nikita: server accepts request but instrumentation shows orchestrator used defaults. So we silently lost scaling config.

rahul: that's bad for Dedicated customers. 2) you mentioned auth/streaming flow?

nikita: yeah — when a streaming request hits 401, REST client does a single refresh-then-retry. Node SDK's streaming wrapper triggers token refresh but also replays the entire stream from client side leading to duplicate chunks and sometimes hitting rate limits (429) on retry.

kevin: do we have a central token refresh hook? SDK should pause the stream, refresh, and resume with a single retry. Sounds like race-condition where multiple chunks race to refresh.

rahul: can you repro with a deterministic script?

nikita: tiny repro attached in sample-apps/streaming/auth-flaky.js — basically expired token + quick reconnect causes two refresh calls in parallel.

flo: action items:
- kevin: check generator config for property name conversion and re-generate Node SDK with camelCase mapping.
- rahul: add a parity e2e that posts scaling object via SDK and asserts orchestrator saw the exact JSON.
- kevin & nikita: triage streaming token refresh: add a lock so only one refresh runs and other streams await the result.

dev-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk-node#501: "node SDK: property name conversion drops camelCase scaling keys; streaming token refresh race -> duplicate retries" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/501 :robot_face:

kevin: I can take the generator fix + hotfix for 1.0.1. rahul, can you own the parity test?

rahul: yes, will add wiremock assertion and a CI job that compares SDK payload to raw curl for critical deployment endpoints.

nikita: thanks — temporary workaround in sample-app is to pass both camelCase and snake_case keys when using SDK (ugh). I'll update the README to note the workaround until the patch lands.

flo: mark this P1 for Dedicated customers.

nikita: thanks all, will link PRs once ready.
